ENGINEERING CHECK, 14 Nov 2026 (verified on an emulator against VM 108 updated to sha-4066593, the merge of #53 = frozen commit 40665932; debug APK build 152 from the same commit; NOT the release-candidate pair; nothing is marked walked). N-15 PASSES. The first start of the new image (12:55 UTC) did not run the artist pass: the cover finder, which runs just before it, found one picture and asked the music server for a scan; the artist pass saw "scanning" and returned empty, and the next pass is an hour away (audit B-127). After one restart of the Encore container the pass ran: 20 artists per pass, each with a one-second pause; first pass wrote artist.jpg for Bob Marley, Bring Me The Horizon, Bullet For My Valentine, AVKRVST and Barus (the others got "none": non-Latin names, channels, labels); the passes after the next restarts wrote Elley DuhÃ©, FousheÃ©, Goo Goo Dolls, Jay-Z, Kings Of Leon, L'Algerino and more (at the second look, 5 minutes after the first pass: 37 artists tried, 8 found, 29 none). The music server's list of artists without a picture fell from 100 to 92 at the first look; its picture route served the new files (image/jpeg 200). Bob Marley and "Bob Marley & The Wailers" share one image (the catalogue's picture of the credit).
ON THE PHONE: Bob Marley's Top result in Search and his artist page showed a real photo, but only after "Sync now" (Settings > Library & sync): the phone's browse index refreshes when the music server's scan moves AND `libraryPassGap` (1 hour; 6 hours on mobile data) has passed, so a new picture reaches a phone within the hour or at once on a manual sync (by design, not a defect; a person who just added music may expect it sooner). Bob Marley's two albums (Kaya, Uprising) still showed letter tiles: no album picture, not N-15.
The Deezer look-ups of both finders run from the server's address at every start (the cover finder looked at 161 songs on the first pass): the Host switch is still B-88/P3-09.
